card.name: Odd symbols and word endings
card.fires_on: Marks such as ~, * or [* after a phrase or number, and the closing piece of long medical words like Hypomania or Necrotizing. Also the word translation after 'Find a'.

modes.label: Symbols after text
modes.description: A tilde, asterisk or bracket-star marker that follows a number, name or phrase.

modes.label: Ends of medical words
modes.description: The final piece of a long condition name split into parts.
modes.example: Activation of Mania or Hypoman<<ia>> : Prior to initiating

card.plain: It fires on small marker symbols and on the last piece of long condition names, with no single meaning.
